verdict.rationale: Mercury Books runs built-in background automation: continuous auto-categorization and real-time reconciliation. Users can also set up some rule-based automations, such as categorization rules via Command, recurring invoices at a chosen frequency, and multi-layered bill approval rules. However, Command is an on-demand assistant rather than a scheduled or triggered agent. The API and MCP layer that would enable user-defined agentic automations are only promised as 'soon'. Mercury itself frames the product as 'not putting your books on autopilot'. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable automation or workflow builder, scheduled or triggered autonomous agent tasks, a shipped API/MCP for building custom background automations, and independent hands-on corroboration.
